newsitem.title: GERMANY: Japan says no G7 disagreement on forex.
newsitem.headline: Japan says no G7 disagreement on forex.

text.p: A Japanese finance ministry official said on Friday it would be wrong to assume that Japan and other Group of Seven members are in disagreement on currencies.
On the eve of a meeting of G7 finance ministers and central bank heads, another official in the Japanese delegation said currency stability was needed to ensure sustainable world economic growth.
In this context, the second official added, Japan would say at the G7 meeting that an overly weak or strong yen is unfavourable.
